item.text: I’ll read the fixture and solve the scheduling objectives in the specified order.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'import json,itertools
x=json.load(open(\"input.json\")); ops=sorted(x[\"operations\"],key=lambda o:o[\"id\"]); h=x[\"horizon\"]; best=None
choices=[o[\"permitted_starts\"] if o[\"permitted_starts\"] is not None else range(h-o[\"duration\"]+1) for o in ops]
for v in itertools.product(*choices):
 s=dict(zip([o[\"id\"] for o in ops],v)); f={o[\"id\"]:s[o[\"id\"]]+o[\"duration\"] for o in ops}
 if any(f[o[\"id\"]]>h or any(f[p]>s[o[\"id\"]] for p in o[\"requires\"]) for o in ops):continue
 if any(sum(o[\"demand\"].get(r,0) for o in ops if s[o[\"id\"]]<=t<f[o[\"id\"]])>cap for r,cap in x[\"capacities\"].items() for t in range(h)):continue
 key=(max(f.values()),sum(s[o[\"id\"]]*o[\"risk_weight\"] for o in ops),v)
 if best is None or key<best:best=key
print(json.dumps({\"starts\":dict(zip([o[\"id\"] for o in ops],best[2])),\"makespan\":best[0],\"risk_exposure\":best[1]}))'"
